title: Performance Marketing Specialist Sao Paulo, Brazil
description:
Our Mission is to be able to say - “Anyone in the World below $15M should fire their Agency tomorrow as nobody can beat this Value & Service at this Price”

We’re looking for a results-driven and experienced Performance Marketing Specialist to join our team.

As a Performance Marketing Specialist at Common Thread Collective (CTC), you will play a key role in scaling client success through strategic media execution and data-driven forecasting. Your expertise will be essential in developing precise performance projections, ensuring campaigns are executed seamlessly to achieve measurable growth. Every decision you make will embody CTC’s core values, reinforcing our dedication to excellence and innovation in performance marketing. At CTC, your trained expertise is invaluable, covering the entire spectrum of CTC’s Strategic Forecasting methods and the foundational principles of media acquisition.

Your role goes beyond delivering measurable business outcomes—it involves proactive collaboration with clients, maintaining clear and transparent communication about strategies, actions taken, and performance relative to forecasts. This ongoing engagement builds trust, strengthens client relationships, and positions CTC as a strategic partner, guiding clients through the complexities of media acquisition and growth strategies.

You stand as a representative and zealous advocate for CTC's unique approach to media acquisition and its accompanying tools.

As a Performance Marketing Specialist, you set a high standard, ensuring that every initiative is executed at the highest level.

You view challenges as opportunities to excel and take great pride in your ability to drive results with precision and impact. At CTC, we embrace the mantra, “Everyday in Everyplay, Count on Me,” meaning we take ownership, deliver excellence, and see things through to the end.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

This place isn’t for everyone, but it might be for you if…

Our core values are the heart and soul of this incredible Company. The right person for this role will appreciate each of these values, personally subscribe to them, and understand why each is critical to having a great business.

To give ourselves our best shot at accomplishing Our mission, we organize all of our decisions—from recruiting, to hiring, to raises, to promotions, to how we spend our time and money—in the direction of three committed values.

We recognize these values aren't for everyone.

They're challenging. In fact, they're so challenging, that's why we invest so much in supporting our team and why we tend to attract people who are craving the opportunity to do more at work than get a paycheck. We're looking for those who are interested in making their work significant.

AUTODIDACT

  • Naturally curious and an autodidact, able to absorb information quickly and effectively, like osmosis. Your commitment to learning sets you apart, absorbing information swiftly and more effectively than your peers.
  • Your openness to both offer and embrace feedback as an opportunity for growth and implement it proactively, without needing constant direction.
  • Demonstrates resourcefulness, and independently refine your skills without being prompted.
  • Thrives in a self-managed environment, showing autonomy, initiative, and a commitment to continuous improvement and not requiring task lists built by their managers and constant oversight.

UNIMPEACHABLE CHARACTER

  • Embodies a character that inspires pride in both personal and professional associations.
  • Consistently honest, with the courage to acknowledge and communicate hard truths, and the humility to accept them, even when uncomfortable, and never lie in any situation.
  • Displays a high level of self-awareness, taking full ownership of outcomes without resorting to a victim mindset.
  • Values constructive feedback and integrates it, understanding nothing great is built without feedback.

COMPETITIVE GREATNESS

  • Performs at their best when it matters most, The Enjoyment of Hard Challenges.
  • Demonstrates an unyielding determination to get things done, regardless of obstacles, time constraints, skills needed, or resources.
  • Adapts to changing circumstances, recognizing that true success is about not just meeting, but exceeding what is required.
  • Possesses a deep passion for their work, using creativity and resilience to overcome any hurdle.

What Success Looks Like

NECESSARY SKILLS

TRAINING PERIOD

  • Be willing to put in the hard work required and be hungry enough to go through the training.
  • Being ready and prepared for this to be the hardest job you have ever worked, as you would fundamentally develop a high-leverage new skill.
  • The ability to take feedback and implement it fast.
  • Finish the work to the fullest with quality and on time.
  • Perseverance.
  • Remember and learn from the repetitive doing of the exercises.

ONBOARDING

  • Align with the team and contribute to the team called Brain Trust for Ideas across clients.
  • Manage, align & work with the team members of your pod including Google strategist, Creative Strategist, and Email Strategist.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple tasks with great attention to detail.
  • Upkeep of data integrity of your clients across Statlas.
  • Be responsible for the execution of the Prophet system for your clients.
  • Building a Growth Forecast for your clients, including building a Growth map using the Prophet System, data analysis required for the map, and marketing calendar alignment and upkeep with clients.
  • The Daily Execution and Actualisation vs the Forecast, making tactical deconstructions and actualizing the projections each day to meet KPIs.
  • Combine data analysis and feedback from clients to develop strategic plans for the future.
  • When it’s time to pivot, you are among the first early adopters.
  • Take a lead in situations that present any obstacle to execution.
  • An insatiable curiosity, and an inability to leave a problem alone until you’ve found one or many different potential solutions.
  • Responsible for the implementation of CTC’s Meta best practices.
  • Build campaigns using our structure and best practices.
  • Upkeep and management of our ideologies and processes throughout the account.
  • Monitoring active campaigns, and adjusting budgets and strategy to ensure the best possible chance of hitting the Daily Projected Targets.
  • Implementing tests in your accounts in an effort to beat your best-performing campaigns.

ENSURING AND HOLDING THE STANDARD OF QUALITY OF WORK

  • Ensuring you are within a 5% Delta to the Forecast.
  • Ensuring daily alignment with the client vs the forecast & strategy.
  • Following the Prophet system execution to 100% within the timeline required.
  • Ensuring all the work is delivered based on the timeline assigned with optimal quality & attention to detail.

Client Communication

  • You are a champion of communication, ensuring the client is aligned on the Growth Map goals and next steps, while making sure everybody on your team has clarity on what is required with exact deadlines.
  • Responsible for sending daily performance updates to the client.
  • Ensure alignment across Strategy and Forecast with the client for every day of the week.
  • Providing weekly updates on the Weekly Strategy Call.

CONTRIBUTING BACK

  • Contributing your learnings back to the system for feedback and continuous improvement.
  • Contributing & collaborating in ideas and learning across teams.
  • Contributing to ideas and learning in future company content production.

NEXT-LEVEL SKILLS

Communication Skills

  • Fluent in English, with a proven ability to communicate persuasively and present ideas clearly to various stakeholders.
  • Skilled in crafting thoughtful, empathetic client messaging that resonates, demonstrating a high level of emotional intelligence.
  • Strong presentation skills, capable of delivering compelling presentations that drive engagement and decision-making.
  • Strong raw talent for data analysis, with an eagerness to learn and improve.
  • Familiarity with data tools, including Google Sheets, with the flexibility to develop advanced skills through on-the-job experience.

Past Experience

  • Historical expertise that compounds to bring a well-rounded perspective and adds value to the role.
  • A breadth of experience from any of the multiple domains, including mathematics, data analytics, business operations, retail, finance, media buying, etc.

Critical Thinking

  • Ability to approach challenges with structured thinking, utilizing logical frameworks to effectively solve complex problems.
  • Naturally adept at dissecting issues and proposing practical, impactful solutions.

Impact

  • Passionate about e-commerce and eager to contribute to a high-performing team at the forefront of the industry.
  • Highly motivated and hardworking, with a strong desire to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.
  • Thrives in environments where they can see the direct results of their actions on the business, with a strong preference for roles that offer full accountability and autonomy.

Results

You will merge the Finance and Marketing sides of a business to build a forecasted strategy to help the business achieve its goal.

  • Achieve certification and confidence in our ideology by the end of training, enabling precise execution of the Prophet system to ensure top-quality results for clients.
  • Consistently deliver high-accuracy performance within a 5% delta across the Prophet system’s Growth Map and Statlas.
  • Lead and collaborate with your team to optimize productivity and maintain high-performance standards.
  • Apply best practices in media buying to drive outstanding results, ensuring no one could achieve better outcomes in your role.
  • Maintain client satisfaction levels above benchmark rates, aligning daily on forecasts to exceed client expectations.
  • Adhere to rigorous quality standards in client feedback, forecasting, media buying decisions, and system execution.
  • Meet all deadlines and budget requirements, ensuring timely and on Target Performance.
  • Contribute valuable ideas to team discussions and company-wide content, supporting growth and innovation.

DOMAIN

MANAGEMENT

  • Your supervisor would be Joy Sharma, The Director of the CTC Accelerator Program.
  • As an Accelerator Strategist, you’ll report directly to Joy Sharma —a leader known for his relentless pursuit of excellence and an unmatched passion for growth strategy. Joy is a rare mentor, often described as the closest you’ll come to learning directly from Taylor Holiday himself. With a career built on his own rigorous, self-driven learning, Joy has transformed numerous team members into top-tier strategists, instilling in them the values of dedication, precision, and continuous improvement.

Working under Joy's guidance will push you to your limits in the best possible way. He models the value of hard work, and learning from him feels like “drinking from a firehose”—you’ll absorb knowledge quickly and consistently, experiencing tremendous growth. Joy is committed to personally ensuring you reach your full potential as a Junior Growth Strategist, supporting your journey every step of the way.

ORIENTATION

  • This role will be client-facing.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR ME?

SALARY RANGE

  • First month: $2,000
  • Second month: $4,000
  • Third month (on average): $7,000 a month
  • 1st Year Annual Range: $64,000-$76,000
  • 2nd Year Annual Range: $100,000-$120,000

This will depend on the amount of clients and the quality of work.

Growth, Transparency, and Fairness in Career Development

  • Progress is Clearly Defined
  • Depends primarily on your experience with the system & quality of execution against it. Following a well-defined path for the first 12 months and how exactly you can grow to be promoted to a Senior Strategist.
  • Fairness and transparency are prioritized
  • Access a weekly performance dashboard to see exactly where you stand compared to team members on both objective and subjective metrics.
  • Pay transparency is upheld for all team members
  • With consistent contract terms and a clear roadmap for increasing earnings, ensuring everyone understands the path to greater compensation. We will also talk monthly about how you can progress.
  • My Commitment to You:
  • You will work harder, learn more than ever before, and “make more than you ever have.” You will gain a diverse skill set while actively contributing to the continuous development of new tools and improvements within our system. In doing so you will have an incredible opportunity for rapid career progression.
  • We will continue to provide you mentorship through every step of your development in the role and promotion from it. We will then continue to provide feedback against the expectation and evaluate against it.
  • Fully remote with the ability to pick your schedule.
  • Embrace autonomy as a core value, with clear expectations, regular 1:1 feedback sessions, and measurable quality benchmarks to support personal growth. Exceptional work is recognized and rewarded, with weekly check-ins for accountability, ensuring you’re consistently challenged and engaged with new opportunities daily.

description:
O Grupo Mult é um dos maiores grupos na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.
Buscamos e valorizamos talentos, pessoas com personalidade, força de vontade e determinação.

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Este banco de talentos é destinado a candidatos que desejam fazer parte do nosso time, mas ainda não encontraram uma vaga ideal. Esperamos poder direcioná-lo para alguma oportunidade em breve.

Como funciona o nosso fluxo:

  1. Quando surgir uma vaga na sua cidade, buscaremos em nosso Banco de Talentos por candidatos compatíveis com o perfil desejado.
  2. Se você atender aos requisitos, entraremos em contato através do seu e-mail para convidá-lo a participar do processo seletivo.
  3. Fique atento às notificações e ao seu e-mail.

Seguimos as determinações da Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados. Portanto, só poderemos movimentar seu cadastro entre as vagas se você autorizar, no seu cadastro, o armazenamento do seu currículo por tempo indeterminado.

O cadastro no Banco de Talentos não garante uma avaliação ou oportunidade imediata. Entraremos em contato quando houver uma vaga que corresponda ao seu perfil.

História do Grupo Mult

A trajetória do Grupo Mult começou com Maxwell Lage, que em julho de 1993 abriu uma revenda de automóveis multimarcas em Governador Valadares (MG). Com o tempo, a empresa se consolidou como uma das maiores na representação de veículos nos estados do Espírito Santo e Minas Gerais.

Para conhecer melhor essa evolução, confira a linha do tempo a seguir:

  1. 1993: Fundação em Governador Valadares (MG). Rápido crescimento, com filiais em Caratinga, Ipatinga e Teófilo Otoni.
  2. 2004: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Mitsubishi Motors e expandiu suas operações para outras cidades de Minas Gerais e Espírito Santo.
  3. 2012: Inauguração da Kobe Nissan, tornando-se referência nacional e recebendo a honraria Revenda Samurai.
  4. 2020: Tornou-se revendedor oficial Renault em Governador Valadares.
  5. 2021: Inauguração da Multicar Mega Store em Vitória (ES) e conquista da concessão da Royal Enfield.
  6. Hoje: Com 16 lojas, incluindo unidades Nissan, Mitsubishi, Renault, Royal Enfield e uma loja de carros esportivos, além de atuar nos setores imobiliário, de seguros e veículos por assinatura.

title: Instock Manager, Mass Vendor Relations
description:
Amazon.com.br is looking for a smart and driven Instock Manager to join our Mass Vendor Relations team in Brazil. The Instock Manager will be responsible for supporting and executing demand planning to maximize product availability, margins and inventory turns with highly scalable processes for thousands of vendors. This person will have responsibility for ensuring inventory systems and processes are meeting the needs of the business and implementing controls around these. The right candidate thrives in a high energy environment where tactical and strategic activities are expected to be driven in parallel.


The Instock Manager will own driving improvement in inventory availability, increasing inventory efficiency, selection growth and improving purchasing processes. The successful candidate possesses a track record of successful implementation and execution of inventory management practices, leveraging strong analytical acumen and working with cross-functional teams. The position requires an individual who can work autonomously in a highly demanding and often ambiguous environment, with strong attention to detail. The candidate should be able to manage multiple vendors simultaneously and make sure items are always available to our customers in Brazil. This role is located in São Paulo, Brazil.


At Amazon Brazil, we value Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions. Therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we engage in and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas, as we understand that this agenda must have different perspectives and multiple experiences. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of 'Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer.' Understanding our responsibility and our need for change, we are conscientious that 'Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility.' Our affinity groups are built from and by volunteers from different businesses, and they are an active part of our DE&I strategies definition. Besides that, they act as ambassadors of this agenda, and they will support you from Day 1. Remember, at Amazon 'It’s always Day 1.' Our groups are organized in the following fronts: BEN - Black Employee Network, , Glamazon (LGBTQIA+), and People With Disabilities.


Key job responsibilities

Inventory & Supply Chain Management:

  1. Manage the supply chain to guarantee an efficient inbound and outbound inventory flows among: forecasting, purchasing, and solving receipts problems
  2. Work with vendors to ensure a reliable and operationally effective flow of goods
  3. Deliver maximum available selection in the category
  4. Design seasonal and promotional inventory preparation plan
  5. Control budgets and deliver actions to meet inventory targets
  6. Execute action plans to reduce return/liquidation costs

Operational Efficiency:

  1. Measure and improve purchasing lead times, reduce operational defects, and improve systems to streamline operations between vendors and Amazon
  2. Perform root cause analysis/reporting on operational issues, develop action plans and manage improvements

Project Management:

  1. Work with internal teams to drive system, tools and process improvements/implementation that affect purchasing and vendor management workflow, with emphasis on automating tasks that are currently performed manually
  2. Develop analysis of key business metrics, with emphasis on developing and executing recommendations for improvement
  3. Lead projects from initial development to implementation that will streamline supply systems and processes and drive operational improvements.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree
- Advanced English Proficiency
- Experience in product/category management or commercial planning.
- Experience in logistics, supply chain and/or supply management

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Knowledge of the principles of statistical inventory control
- Experience with process improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma
- Proficiency in SQL and database concepts

• Proven ability to liaise with law enforcement, government agencies, and regulatory bodies.

• Ability to travel between Laguna, Cavite, and Eastwood sites and provide on-call emergency response support.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

• Regular coordination with senior management, local law enforcement, and government agencies.

description:
Program Overview : Chemonics International, a US-based international development consulting firm, seeks a Procurement and Logistics Specialist for the USAID Iraq Together project. Iraq Together aims to provide more equitable, efficient, and sustainable public services in Iraq, as well as improving government responsiveness to citizens’ needs and demands. Objectives of this project include working with the Government of Iraq (GOI) to improve service delivery and strengthen democratic and participatory governance.

Position Overview: The Procurement and Logistics Associate will be responsible for leading the technical and operational procurement processes on Iraq Together, in coordination with the Operations Director and their team. The individual will ensure quality standards are met, and all procurements are cost-effective and compliant with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, and Iraqi government laws. This role will oversee the full procurement cycle, including support to the program teams as required, and lead the logistical operations of the project activities and office facilities. This position is open to Iraqi nationals residing in Baghdad, Iraq.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Preserve the integrity of the procurement process, including drafting project procurement documents including all solicitations, negotiation memos, consents to subcontract, and applicable waivers.
  • Maintain organized and concise procurement files that document project compliance with USAID rules and regulations, Chemonics policies and procedures, as well as local, third country, or US government rules that affect the procurement process.
  • Provide guidance to technical and operational staff on procurement/compliance policies, in particular those contained in FAR, CFR, ADS, and AIDAR regulating procurement.
  • Enforce clear and transparent procurement procedures.
  • Work directly with local, regional, or international vendors and service providers to obtain quotations and/or to conduct procurements of commodities or services.
  • Monitor contracts and purchase orders and conduct follow-up as necessary to ensure compliance with terms and conditions.
  • Compile all required documentation to facilitate payment requests.
  • Organize and participate in internal evaluation committees.
  • Monitor for any procurement-related conflict of interest and ensure the project’s procurement process is open and transparent.
  • Work with project leadership to answer any questions or provide USAID with any requested information about project procurements.
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of procurement, subcontracts and grants required.
  • Experience working for USAID or other donor funded projects strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience and understanding of procurement procedures of international organizations.
  • Strong organizational, management, and administrative skills.
  • Willingness and ability to work efficiently and respectfully with a diverse group of people.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, in particular Excel, Word, SharePoint, and Outlook.
  • Demonstrated leadership, versatility, and integrity.
  • Proficiency in written and oral Arabic and English is required; written and oral fluency in Kurdish, and other local languages is a plus, but not required.

title: Senior Data Engineer Data Solutions
description:
Apply now for a career that puts wellbeing first!

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Engineer for our Data Solutions squad in Brazil !

Join our growing Data team at Wellhub and contribute to our data democratization mission: make data accessible to everyone! We are responsible for empowering all teams by providing a scalable and reliable data platform to collect, organize, and process the deluge of data generated daily at Wellhub, following data modeling and governance best practices. Your work will directly impact our goal of enabling all teams to make data-driven decisions and generate business value from data.

We use data and software engineering principles to solve large-scale production challenges. Our infrastructure is completely in the cloud, running Kubernetes, Trino, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, Flink, and more cutting-edge projects.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Design and implement innovative data solutions that enhance automation, efficiency, and productivity for data practitioners across the organization.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to architect and develop in-house data solutions that meet organizational needs.
  • Lead the evaluation and integration of cutting-edge technologies to optimize our data and machine learning processes.
  • Ensure robust data architecture and technical product integration, enhancing the overall data ecosystem.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Hands-on expertise in data engineering and architecture, with the ability to follow software engineering best practices.
  • Experience in building in-house solutions to address common data engineering patterns.
  • Proficient in CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes.
  • Strong understanding of data lakehouse design and technical integration with products.
  • Passionate about data democratization, making data accessible and useful across the organization.
  • Familiarity with data management tools (e.g. OpenMetadata) and/or MLOps frameworks (e.g., Metaflow, Kubeflow).
  • Previous experience in a cloud-based infrastructure, preferably using AWS stack is a plus.
  • Experience with scalable data processing and storage solutions (e.g., S3 Management, Trino, Hive Metastore) is a plus.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that experience working with CDC, Flink, Spark, Airflow, Trino, and Kubernetes, as well as an advanced level of English are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and well-being of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day.

And to get a glimpse of Life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @wellhublife and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

  • May integrate and interlock with other functional areas to ensure functional work stream impacts are understood and factored in the overall solution.
  • Participate in the creation of documentation, tools and assets to enable reusable knowledge capital.
  • Execute account financial processes to ensure the quality and integrity of contract/project financial records.

Must have:

· Bachelor's degree in Finance or Accounting OR Other business degree

· 3+ years of experience in a financial role

· Strong organizational and analytical skills

· Ability to be flexible and work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment

· Excellent customer service skills

· Good interpersonal and teamwork skills.

· Proven ability to supervise junior team members

· Deep knowledge of business, finance and accounting fundamentals including U.S. Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP)

· SAP S4/ Hana experience

· Advanced Business English language (written and oral)

· Advanced Microsoft Excel skills

· Foreign Language skills on top of English (Portuguese, Spanish)

title: Analista de Compras
description:
A Magnesium do Brasil é líder de negócios em pesquisa, beneficiamento e comercialização de magnesita. Pertencemos ao Groupe Roullier, que movido por uma energia coletiva, atua internacionalmente há mais de 60 anos em 8 áreas de atividade (Indústria Alimentar, Agrosupply, Fosfatos Alimentares, Magnésio, Nutrição Vegetal para o Público em Geral, Embalagem, Algologia e Energias Renováveis).

Todos os nossos funcionários incorporam nossos valores diariamente: Espírito de Equipe, Segurança, Desenvolvimento, Responsabilidade e Inovação. Comprometida com o desenvolvimento e a melhoria contínua, a Magnesium do Brasil está em constante evolução, colocando a experiência dos seus colaboradores no centro de todas as suas preocupações de gestão.

Nessa função, você terá a oportunidade de:

  • Participar ativamente da gestão das solicitações de compras do escopo de MRO, garantindo processos alinhados às demandas da fábrica.
  • Colaborar com as áreas internas, promovendo o entendimento das necessidades e sugerindo melhorias nos processos de compras.

Você será responsável por:

  • Gerenciar as solicitações de compras relacionadas ao escopo de MRO, garantindo que os processos sejam realizados de forma eficiente e alinhada às necessidades operacionais da fábrica.
  • Atender com qualidade e assertividade os pedidos dos clientes internos, assegurando a entrega de soluções que atendam aos prazos, padrões de qualidade e custos esperados.
  • Negociar com fornecedores, buscando as melhores condições comerciais e parcerias estratégicas.
  • Manter um relacionamento próximo com as áreas internas para entender as demandas e propor melhorias contínuas nos processos de compras.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos fornecedores, avaliando critérios como pontualidade, qualidade e custo-benefício.

Um ambiente cheio de desafios, com oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento. Nossa fábrica possui um ambiente de trabalho respeitoso e alegre, resultado da nossa cultura.

Por que juntar-se a nós?

Juntar-se a nós é atrever-se a fazer a diferença, a tomar iniciativas, a saber transformar dificuldades em oportunidades e a colocar o seu talento ao serviço de um coletivo, de uma ambição partilhada: Crescer Juntos é caminhar juntos na mesma direção.

  • Nível intermediário no Pacote Office (Excel, Word e PowerPoint)
  • Experiência com MRO será um diferencial
Fundada em 1905, a Magnesium do Brasil foi 100% adquirida pelo Grupo Roullier em 2021 – multinacional francesa com faturamento anual superior a 4 bilhões de Euros, mais de 10.400 colaboradores e presente em todos os continentes.
Da extração ao tratamento da matéria-prima e com grandes esforços empesquisa e desenvolvimento, a Magnesium do Brasil tem por missão revelar opotencial do magnésio e tornar-se referência global nos mercados de nutriçãoanimal, fertilizantes, aplicações refratárias e outras aplicações industriais.
Após a aquisição de 100% pelo Grupo Roullier, sustentada por um importante processo de investimento em capacidade produtiva, a empresa consolida-se como fornecedor sólido e confiável para o mercado.
A Magnesium do Brasil mantém um firme compromisso com a responsabilidade sócio-econômica-ambiental, tendo um impacto significativo no desenvolvimento de seus colaboradores e das comunidades onde está inserida.
Espírito de equipe, segurança, desenvolvimento, responsabilidade e inovação são os valores que integram o DNA da Magnesium do Brasil. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Client Advocate - Commercial Insurance (Retail and Distribution)
description:
Description

The Client Advocate is responsible for maintaining and cultivating client relationships. The Client Advocate role has a strong connection to the client’s business and a fundamental understanding of its industry. The Client Advocatecontributes to and generates new opportunities with prospects by developing and closing on expanded business services, products and solutions with existing clients. Client Advocates drive the RFP response process including coordination of key internal stakeholders, work in conjunction with the RFP team on the overall response presentation and participate in or lead the oral presentation.As a Client Advocate are responsible with developing innovative solutions. Client facing responsibilities expected to be 90%.

A Client Advocate (CA) will need to have:

  • Strong negotiation skills
  • Strong management skills (mentoring and leading ACAs)
  • Strong project management skills
  • Strong presentation skills
  • An advocate for change

Note: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity.
The Role

As a senior member of the organization, you will have additional responsibility serving as:

  • A mentor to colleagues
  • A Subject Matter Expert for one or more lines of business and/or Industry Vertical and/or
  • A Team Leader
  • Contributes to new business opportunities for new clients and develops business opportunities with existing clients
  • Drives the RFP response process, including review, identification, and coordination of resources and expertise required, and ultimate document ownership
  • Engages with sales and broking to understand marketplace changes
  • Retains existing book of business and develop and strengthen client relationships – recognized as primary client relationship contact
  • Establishes comprehensive understanding of client’s industry, business, and objectives
  • Provides strategic planning and consulting advice to clients; monitors insurance and risk management needs in collaboration with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups. Recommends appropriate solutions throughout the policy term (including acquisition due diligence)
  • Drives creation and delivery of E365 Plan and Client Stewardship report
  • Identifies, engages, and integrates delivery of all WTW internal resources to deliver on the client experience
  • Leads and mentors account team members
  • Maximizes the profitability and retention of their book of business
  • Negotiates, creates, and delivers fee/compensation agreements to clients
  • Informs client’s insurance program design and strategy by working in conjunction with Broking to ensure utilization of appropriate analytical tools
  • Drives design and delivery of client presentations/proposals, client advocacy reports, client service plans and schedules
  • Drives the renewal process to establish and implement the client-specific renewal strategy. Collaborates with WTW resource, practice, and industry groups to develop and deliver renewal to clients.
  • Ensures Group policy requirements (legal, regulatory & compliance) are met
  • Other duties as identified and appropriate to ensure exceptional client experience

Qualifications

The Requirements

  • Targeted 8+ years of commercial Property & Casualty experience in a client facing role or demonstrated capabilities to complete role responsibilities
  • Able to apply knowledge of coverage forms in the analysis of program design, the identification of coverage gaps, and ongoing coverage consultation
  • Ability to interpret, analyze, and present analytical models
  • Relationship Management skills: able to leverage internal and external relationships to bring WTW resources and assets tailored to client needs; ability to drive conflict resolution
  • Negotiation skills: Ability to develop innovative and creative solutions to do complex deals, drive consensus across internal and external stakeholders to close deals and theability to drive conflict resolution and secure concessions mitigating injury to client relationships
  • Business Acumen; knowledge of strategy, tactics, and solutions for the client, and/or in the marketplace
  • Knowledge of commercial insurance renewal end-to-end process, steps and owners
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; group presentation skills, ability to drive complex/technical conversations
  • Excellent project management skills: end-to-end oversight of large, complex, ambiguous, or multi-dimensional projects
  • Effectively advocates for change. Provides encouragement, takes control of team projects, leads key work areas, collaborates with others, provides clear guidance to ensure others fulfill roles effectively
  • Receptive to feedback; critical thinking and problem-solving skills, high adaptability
  • Intellectual curiosity to help develop innovative and creative ideas
  • Proficient Microsoft Office skills and familiarity with other relevant online tools
  • Must achieve and maintain insurance brokers P&C license and complete various continuing education activities as needed
  • Insurance industry designations preferred but not required (CPCU, ARM, CIC, CRIS, CRM)

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.
Compensation and Benefits

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that base salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role and potential for revenue generation.

Compensation

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $120,000-$140,000 USDper year.

This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

Company Benefits

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

  • Health and Welfare Benefits: Medical (including prescription coverage), Dental, Vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Account, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, Group Accident, Group Critical Illness, Life Insurance, AD&D, Group Legal, Identify Theft Protection, Wellbeing Program and Work/Life Resources (including Employee Assistance Program)
  • Leave Benefits: Paid Holidays, Annual Paid Time Off (includes paid state/local paid leave where required), Short-Term Disability, Long-Term Disability, Other Leaves (e.g., Bereavement, FMLA, ADA, Jury Duty, Military Leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off (Washington State only )

description:
ACES FC Process Manager - Reverse Logistics, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Manager ReLo (Reverse Logistics) for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.
You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Manager, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.
Key job responsibilities
Your core activities and responsibilities include:
- being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
- leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
- leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
- owning and managing change on a granular level;
- performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
- work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
- make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.
A day in the life
You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:
- FC Ops;
- Middle Mile and Last Mile teams;
- Learning;
- Finance;
- HR;
- Loss Prevention.
You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.
About the team
The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree.
- Experience with program or project management;
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams;
- Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics;
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL;
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
- Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus);
- Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience;
- Experience driving complex process improvements;
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization;
- Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
- Black Belt certification

description:
People are at the heart of everything we do at TK Elevator: we work as a team, we care about the safety of others and we share a common vision to keep the world moving. This is your opportunity to go further and impact the future of urban mobility.

We are seeking a Digital Solutions System Architect to lead the high-level design and technical direction of our global elevator digital solutions. This role will oversee the architecture of embedded systems, IoT solutions, and connectivity platforms, ensuring seamless integration, security, and scalability across our next-generation elevator technology. The ideal candidate will be responsible for defining best practices, making key technology decisions, and acting as a technical liaison between teams to drive innovation and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • High-Level System Design: Define the architectural vision and technical roadmap for IoT-enabled digital elevator solutions, ensuring alignment with business and security requirements.
  • Technical Leadership: Guide and mentor development teams in implementing robust, scalable, and maintainable digital solutions.
  • System Architecture Modeling: Create and maintain UML diagrams, system models, and technical documentation to ensure clarity and consistency in system design.
  • Problem Solving & Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve technical challenges, ensuring reliability and performance of digital elevator solutions.
  • Technology & Tooling Decisions: Select appropriate development platforms, frameworks, tools, and environments for digital projects.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a technical liaison between embedded software teams, security teams, cloud infrastructure teams, and external partners.
  • Security & Compliance: Work closely with security specialists to integrate cybersecurity best practices into all phases of the development lifecycle.
  • Performance Optimization: Ensure that all software and system designs are optimized for performance, efficiency, and scalability.

Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field with exceptional GPA.

Experience:

  • 5-7 years experience with computer science or software engineering related project work in embedded development (preferably in projects involving complex systems similar to elevator and escalators).

Technical Skills:

  • Outstanding programming skills with expertise in one or more languages: C, C++, C#, Java, Python.
  • Deep knowledge of UML and system modeling methodologies.
  • Strong background in embedded systems, IoT protocols, and cloud integration.
  • Experience with cybersecurity principles, secure development lifecycle, and compliance standards.
  • Knowledge of real-time operating systems (RTOS), Linux embedded, and microcontroller architectures.
  • Familiarity with communication protocols such as CAN, RS485, MQTT, and industrial IoT standards.
  • Strong understanding of linear algebra, discrete mathematics, calculus, and statistics.
  • Experience with hardware development and manufacturing processes are desired.
  • Experience with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and automation frameworks is a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Outstanding creative thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills, able to convey complex ideas to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Exceptional leadership with a collaborative, upbeat personality.
  • Ability to work in a global, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and adjusting to shifting requirements.

Language:

  • Proficient English communication skills, both written and spoken. Knowledge of additional languages, such as German and/or Spanish, are beneficial.

title: FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fullfillment by Amazon
description:
FBA FC Operations Program Manager, FBA - Fulfillment by Amazon

At Amazon Brazil we value Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) in all our job positions, therefore, we act intentionally so that our internal environment reflects the plurality of the businesses we play and the customers we serve. In Brazil, we have a Diversity, Equity and Inclusion squad, which is formed by representatives from different roles and areas. Our leadership is committed and understands more and more their role in sharing and acting on our leadership principles, with the purpose of ‘Strive to Be Earth's Best Employer’. Understanding our responsibility and our need for change is essential.


Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast-paced, innovative company? Come make history in Amazon’s Brazil team! Amazon strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company, where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. Over 2 million Sellers in 10 countries list their products for sale on Amazon. Sellers are a critical part of Amazon’s ecosystem to deliver on our vision of offering the Earth’s largest selection and lowest prices.


We are looking for a Program Manager for Amazon to support FBA (Fulfillment By Amazon) Brazil. This position will be based in an Amazon FC and will support the FBA team to manage its operations. This PM will work closely with various stakeholders (Operations, S&OP, Program, Sales, Operations, Transportation, Legal, etc.) to drive strategic and tactical initiatives to improve FBA operations, including Inbound, Outbound, and Inventory Management. This position will focus on process improvements across teams, identifying areas of opportunities, mapping processes, and proposing optimizations, as well as managing daily operations. He/She will build and own metrics and reports and review performance metrics, being the bridge between FC operations and Business teams.


Key Job Responsibilities

The key responsibilities for this role include:

  1. Act as the link between FC Operations and FBA Business teams
  2. Identify gaps, pain points, and opportunities in the existing processes and propose improvements
  3. Dive Deep on issues to differentiate isolated issues from structural ones
  4. Own metrics and reports, as well as keeping track of key metrics and initiatives impact
  5. Be creative to create solutions that address pain points/opportunities and improve Seller Experience
  6. Calculate impact/potential of ideas/pain points, making it tangible
  7. Influence and support the Product team (both Latam and global teams) on Roadmap prioritization
  8. Suggest/create programmatic solutions and initiatives while creating business cases for the Product team
  9. Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, make trade-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints

About the Team

FBA is one key team in Amazon BR. We manage the operations for sellers that send their inventory to our Fulfillment Center (FC) - from collecting their products to delivering them to customers and receiving customers' returns. In FBA, we have several teams that manage SX and operations in this business model. Fulfillment Operations is one of the teams, and we manage the whole inventory once it's received in the FC: Inventory management, removals, customer returns, reimbursements, and operational processes. We are a data-driven team that owns metrics tracking and evolution, maps gaps, and implements improvements to impact our sellers and customers.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- 3+ years of driving end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: ACES FC Process Specialist - Outbound, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)
description:
ACES FC Process Specialist - Outbound, Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES)

As a Process Specialist for Amazon's Fulfillment Centers, you will be the guardian of quality control at Earth's most customer-centric company! More specifically, you will be responsible for the adoption and continuous improvement of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) across our FC network.
You will work with teams across Operations, Learning, Finance, and other supporting functions in order to find defects and opportunities, measure performance, and track changes. As an ACES Process Specialist, you are the Subject Matter Expert on all processes and are expected to catalog and share this expertise with your stakeholders in a clear and scalable manner.
Key job responsibilities
Your core activities and responsibilities include:
- being the Subject Matter Expert (SME) on all operational processes;
- leading process integration efforts at our Fulfillment Centers (FCs);
- leading Continuous Improvement initiatives, Kaizens, Root Cause Analysis, etc.;
- owning and managing change on a granular level;
- performing audits to ensure continuous SOP adoption and eliminate defects and deviations;
- work with teams both inside and outside of Operations to identify opportunities for improvement;
- make sure that we are always delivering the best possible service to our customers.
A day in the life
You will be working closely with all Ops teams to offer support and expertise and gain an insight into bottlenecks and opportunities for improvement. Some of these teams include:
- FC Ops;
- Middle Mile and Last Mile teams;
- Learning;
- Finance;
- HR;
- Loss Prevention.
You will also work with your counterparts in other geographies to benchmark our processes and ensure conformity with Amazon Standard Work.
About the team
The Amazon Customer Excellence System (ACES) team is a team of highly qualified individuals whose main goal is to safeguard the quality and productivity of our operations and find ways to continuously improve and innovate. We do this by keeping a close eye on metrics, making sure that we are constantly raising the bar on performance and efficiency. We are also responsible for the adoption of new technology and procedures as well as supporting our peers with subject matter expertise.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree.
- Experience with program or project management;
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams;
- Experience defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics;
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL;
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements.
- Lean Six Sigma experience (certification a plus);
- Advanced English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience;
- Experience driving complex process improvements;
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization;
- Experience building processes, project management and schedules.
- Black Belt certification

title: Monster Ambassador Team (MAT)
description:
Resumo da Vaga
O Monster Ambassador Team é um programa de marketing global da Monster Energy Company. O objetivo do programa é:

  1. Gerar experimentação/degustação de produtos Monster Energy Drink pelos consumidores.
  2. Comunicar a mensagem/pilares da Marca MEC (Monster Energy Company) estrategicamente aos consumidores. Exemplo de atuação: Esportes de ação, Automobilismo, Música e Gaming.
  3. Auxiliar na geração de leads para a divisão de vendas.
  4. Desenvolver e fortalecer relacionamentos com key accounts.
  5. Construir redes de influência na região.
  6. Apoiar os esforços de vendas por meio de sampling em eventos e merchandising (caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader).

Funções essenciais da vaga:

Os embaixadores terão várias funções e responsabilidades relacionadas ao engajamento do consumidor e merchandising, incluindo, mas não se limitando ao seguinte:

  1. Gerar ativamente a degustação de Monster Energy durante o sampling de guerrilha.
  2. Abordar consumidores que “precisam” de energia e fazer a degustação.
  3. Distribuir brindes aos consumidores para reforçar a fidelidade à marca.
  4. Executar eventos, de todos os níveis, incluindo os eventos de Base, para esportes e cultura com foco na experiência da marca. Se necessário, coordenar ativações com agências e parceiros.
  5. Desenvolver redes pessoais de relacionamentos internos e externos eficazes, incluindo Equipes de Engarrafadores do Sistema KO.
  6. Cooperar com outros membros da equipe.
  7. Acompanhar as atividades dos concorrentes da marca em campo e relatar em tempo hábil.
  8. Responsabilizar-se pelo bom uso dos materiais e recursos do programa da empresa Monster Energy.
  9. Ser pontual e cumprir o turno agendado pelo supervisor direto.
  10. Manter a aparência da marca usando uniforme adequado, mantendo hábitos de higiene de imagem pessoal conforme sugerido no manual de treinamento.
  11. Garantir profissionalismo, comunicação excepcional e interações proativas com consumidores e colegas de trabalho.
  12. Responder em tempo hábil ao MAT Leader e ao Regional MAT Manager.
  13. Pode ser necessário viajar - Caso requisitado.

Merchandising (Caso solicitado pelo MAT Leader)
• Promover produtos MEC em geladeiras e em coolers.
• Conforme designado, realizar verificações de rotina nas lojas para garantir que as gôndolas estejam abastecidas com os produtos MEC de acordo com as sugestões do MAT Leader e TDM.
• Verificar se todos os Pontos de Venda (PDV) estão positivados corretamente e com precisão ao nível da loja, incluindo; mas não limitado a preços, sinalização promocional e displays.
• Transmitir dados obtidos no mercado com MAT Leader e TDM.
• Gerenciar com responsabilidade todos os materiais e ativos do programa da Monster Energy Co.
Deve relatar quaisquer questões relacionados aos funcionários do PDV ao MAT Leader alinhado com o TDM.

Requisitos da Vaga:
• Deve ter 21 anos ou mais.
• Deve ter um registro de condução limpo.
• Deve ser capaz de levantar até 19 kg, estar fisicamente apto e ativo.
• Deve ser capaz de ficar em pé por longos períodos de tempo.
• Ter um alto nível de energia com uma atitude de “consigo fazer”.
• Preocupar-se com a imagem pessoal e higiene.
• Ser socialmente responsável, extrovertido e prezar pela diversidade.
• Ter interesse em esportes de ação é um extra.
• Experiência promocional é um extra.
• Domínio fluente de inglês, espanhol ou outros idiomas é um extra.

Monster Energy is more than an energy drink, it is a lifestyle! We support the scene, our bands, our athletes, and our fans. We back athletes so they can make careers out of their passions. We strive to create immersive and authentic experiences that inspire.

We celebrate with our fans and riders and employees!

We are a brand that represents being the best at what we do. Join Us!

The ideal candidate will have a strong passion for creating visually stunning designs that effectively communicate our brand story and values. As the lead designer, you will be responsible for developing and executing a cohesive visual identity across all touchpoints, from packaging to digital media.

Tasks

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Develop and refine Frank & Myra's brand identity, including logo design, color palettes, typography, and visual guidelines.
  2. Design compelling product packaging for our line of essential oils, hydrosols, and resins that balances aesthetics, functionality, and sustainability.
  3. Create marketing collateral such as brochures, flyers, catalogs, and point-of-purchase displays that engage customers and drive sales.
  4. Collaborate with the marketing team to design digital assets, including website graphics, social media visuals, email templates, and online advertisements.
  5. Produce outstanding product photography and lifestyle imagery that showcases our products and resonates with our target audience.
  6. Ensure brand consistency across all design elements and platforms, maintaining the highest standards of quality and attention to detail.
  7. Stay up-to-date with industry trends, consumer preferences, and emerging design technologies to continuously innovate and improve our visual communications.
  8. Work closely with cross-functional teams, including product development, marketing, and operations, to align design strategies with business objectives and timelines.
  9. Manage relationships with external vendors, such as printers and packaging suppliers, to ensure quality control and cost-effectiveness.
  10. Provide creative direction and mentorship to junior designers or freelancers as the company grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional experience in brand identity development and packaging design, preferably in the wellness or beauty industry.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating expertise in brand strategy, packaging design, digital media, and photography.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design software.
  • Excellent understanding of color theory, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy.
  • Familiarity with printing processes, packaging materials, and sustainable design practices.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Passion for wellness, natural products, and sustainable living.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree in Design or a related field.
  • Experience with motion graphics, video editing, or 3D rendering.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles and web design best practices.
  • Familiarity with aromatherapy, essential oils, and natural wellness products.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to grow with a small, mission-driven company.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Arrangements
  • Professional Development
  • Wellness Initiatives
  • Community Engagement

At Frank & Myra, we are committed to creating exceptional products that promote well-being while adhering to the highest standards of ethics and sustainability. As our Brand and Creative Designer, you will play a crucial role in shaping our visual identity and communicating our values to the world. We offer a supportive, collaborative work environment, opportunities for professional growth, and the chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of our customers and communities.

To apply, please submit your resume, portfolio, and a cover letter expressing your interest in the position and why you believe you would be a great fit for Frank & Myra. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to our team

title: Product Mechanical Engineer
description:
Why join us

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

As a Mechanical Engineer at Tractian, you'll drive the innovation and development of our IIoT solutions. Collaborating across teams, you'll apply your expertise in mechanics and design to create high-performance products that redefine industrial asset management. From concept to execution, your role will shape Tractian's industry-leading technology, ensuring top-tier quality and functionality in every solution we deliver.

Responsibilities

  • Utilize Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software to create detailed models and drawings of components and assemblies.
  • Employ CAE tools and techniques to perform FEA simulations, including Moldflow, Fatigue, Thermal, structural, and Modal Analyses.
  • Analyze simulation results to evaluate product performance, identify potential issues, and recommend design improvements.
  • Collaborate with the design team to optimize product designs for factors such as strength, durability, and thermal performance.
  • Provide guidance on material selection based on specs and test results to enhance product performance and reliability.
  • Design parts for manufacturing (DFM), understand manufacturer capabilities, and have a strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as machining and plastic injection.
  • Prototype and test mechanical designs to validate performance and functionality, iterating as necessary.
  • Participate in design reviews to provide valuable insights, feedback, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in mechanical design and engineering, preferably in the technology or manufacturing sector.
  • Strong understanding of CAE software tools, such as ANSYS, SolidWorks Simulation, COMSOL, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of mechanics, materials science, and design principles.
  • Proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software, such as SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or similar tools.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, such as machining and plastic injection.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Reading and writing proficiency in English.

Bonus points

  • Experience with microcasting and sintering.
  • Familiarity with plastic materials.
  • Experience in the IoT or industrial equipment sector is advantageous.
Compensation:
  • Competitive salary and stock options.
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses.
  • 30 days of paid annual leave.
  • Education and courses stipend.
  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years.
  • Day off during the week of your birthday.
  • Up to R$1.000/mo for meals and remote work allowance.
  • Health plan with national coverage and without coparticipation.
  • Dental Insurance: we help you with dental treatment for a better quality of life.
  • Gympass and Sports Incentive: R$300/mo extra if you practice activities.

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Apoio ao Planejamento Pedagógico: Auxiliar na elaboração e organização do planejamento anual e semestral, contribuindo com a preparação de materiais e cronogramas.

  • Suporte em Reuniões e Eventos: Organizar a agenda da coordenação pedagógica, agendando e preparando reuniões, palestras e workshops. Auxiliar na logística de eventos escolares, garantindo que todas as necessidades sejam atendidas de forma eficiente.
  • Acompanhamento do Desempenho dos Alunos: Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores de desempenho acadêmico, realizando levantamentos de notas, frequência e outras métricas. Colaborar na identificação de alunos que necessitam de apoio adicional, encaminhando-os para as devidas ações pedagógicas.
  • Apoio na Formação Continuada dos Professores: Auxiliar na organização e logística de treinamentos, workshops e atividades de desenvolvimento profissional para a equipe docente. Preparar materiais de apoio e recursos necessários para as capacitações.
  • Controle de Materiais e Recursos Pedagógicos: Gerenciar o estoque de materiais didáticos e administrativos, solicitando reposições quando necessário. Assegurar que os professores tenham acesso aos recursos necessários para o desenvolvimento de suas atividades.
  • Colaboração em Projetos Pedagógicos: Participar da implementação e acompanhamento de projetos pedagógicos, garantindo que sejam executados conforme o planejado. Auxiliar na avaliação dos resultados dos projetos, propondo melhorias e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Suporte em Processos Administrativos: Auxiliar nas tarefas administrativas diárias, como organização de horários, gestão de substituições e acompanhamento de cronogramas. Colaborar com outros setores da escola para garantir o bom funcionamento das operações pedagógicas e administrativas.
  • Mediação de Conflitos Menores: Auxiliar na resolução de conflitos entre alunos, professores e pais, promovendo um ambiente escolar harmonioso. Encaminhar questões mais complexas para a coordenação pedagógica ou direção escolar.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Formação Acadêmica: Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Pedagogia, Administração Educacional ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência prévia em funções de suporte pedagógico, secretaria escolar ou atividades administrativas no ambiente educacional é desejável. Vivência em atendimento ao público e gestão de documentação escolar.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Familiaridade com ferramentas de gestão escolar e pacotes de software como Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Noções de metodologias de ensino e planejamento pedagógico.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Organização e atenção aos detalhes para gerenciar múltiplas tarefas e manter registros precisos. Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita para interagir eficazmente com professores, alunos e pais. Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas de forma eficiente. Capacidade de Trabalho em Equipe: Habilidade para colaborar com diferentes setores da escola, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho cooperativo. Disposição para apoiar e auxiliar a coordenação pedagógica em todas as suas demandas. description:
CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:
A AVSI Brasil ( é uma organização brasileira, sem fins lucrativos, constituída em 2007, para contribuir na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas que vivem em situações de vulnerabilidade. É uma organização local vinculada ao contexto internacional, por meio da parceria com a Fundação AVSI, ONG de origem italiana que atua no Brasil desde os anos 80 e que estimulou a criação da AVSI Brasil. Sua missão é tornar as pessoas, em situações de vulnerabilidade ou emergência humanitária, protagonistas do próprio desenvolvimento, da sua família e comunidade, por meio de projetos sociais em diferentes áreas.

Neste contexto a AVSI mobiliza, operacionaliza e gerencia os Programas Sociais de Sustentabilidade da ENEL São Paulo, implementando iniciativas de eficiência energética e engajamento comunitário em comunidades de baixa renda. Os programas são estruturados em quatro diretrizes: Relacionamento com a comunidade; Desenvolvimento local; Educação para o consumo consciente de energia.

DESCRIÇÃO RESUMIDA DO CARGO:

O (a) Agente de Campo (a) terá como principal atividade realizar visitas domiciliares para transmissão de informações que contribuam para redução do consumo de energia elétrica e implementação de outras atividades do projeto.

PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES E RESPONSABILIDADES DO CARGO:

  1. Conceder dicas de consumo consciente que contribuam diretamente para reduzir o desperdício de energia;
  2. Atender demandas comerciais do cliente ou indicar os caminhos para que possam ser solucionadas;
  3. Aplicar o questionário socioeconômico através de sistema online;
  4. Orientação e realização do Cadastramento de clientes na Tarifa Social de Energia Elétrica;
  5. Realizar indicações de clientes para outros projetos de Eficiência Energética;
  6. Identificar potenciais instituições para a execução de outras atividades de Eficiência Energética;
  7. Identificar pessoas de referência e/ou líderes comunitários da localidade e reportar internamente;
  8. Entregar e realizar controle de entrega de atendimentos e serviços comerciais realizados pela equipe;
  9. Efetuar trocas de lâmpadas, conforme necessidade da atuação do agente;
  10. Divulgar os projetos, apoiando em atividades e eventos externos.

  • Sonho grande: Miramos no impossível, acreditamos que ele pode se tornar realidade, e chegamos lá juntos.
  • Mente aberta: Nossa abertura para o novo e nossa capacidade de adaptação são o que nos fazem evoluir e melhorar sempre.
  • Espírito empreendedor: Construímos o futuro com nossas próprias mãos com o mais alto nível de comprometimento e sentimento de dono.

XP Future 2025 | Transição de Carreira - Belo Horizonte

Tem perfil comercial, busca transição de carreira e quer fazer parte de um time de alta performance?

Conheça o XP FUTURE, uma iniciativa disruptiva para profissionais com alto skill comercial e que desejam se tornar assessores de investimentos. Essa é uma oportunidade para profissionais que estão em busca de uma transição de carreira e possuem experiência comercial para migrarem para o mercado financeiro.

Na XP Inc. você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de vendas, prospecção de clientes, aprofundamento nos produtos de investimentos e, principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira para que você se torne um profissional comercial de sucesso na corretora e tire a certificação CPA-20 para se tornar um assessor referência no mercado!

Estamos em Belo Horizonte para realizar o processo seletivo e expandir ainda mais nosso time!

Se você já possui experiência comercial em outros segmentos e deseja fazer uma transição de carreira para o mercado financeiro, conheça os pré-requisitos para iniciar em nosso Programa de Formação XP Future:

  • Ter a nossa cultura;
  • Graduação superior completa;
  • Perfil comercial e relacional;
  • Experiência comercial (diferencial como Hunter - prospecção de novos negócios);
  • Curiosidade sobre o mundo dos investimentos;
  • Interesse por realizar uma transição de carreira;
  • Conhecimento básico sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • Estar atuando em outros segmentos de mercado (Meios de pagamentos, adquirência, bebidas, fintechs, etc);
  • Não ser um Assessor de Investimentos ou Agente Autônomo (AAI).

Diferenciais, mas não eliminatórios:

  • Certificação CPA-20.

Principais desafios da cadeira:

  • Prospecção de novos negócios - poder de originação/novos clientes;
  • Organização para trabalhar diversas frentes em curto período de tempo;
  • Forte poder de persuasão;
  • Empatia e visão de longo prazo;
  • Gestão de carteiras e grandes contas - Pessoa Física e Pessoa Jurídica.

Obs: Contratação CLT

  • Realização da etapa de testes - Fit cultural e PI (Obrigatórios);

Job Description


Na AbbVie nossos princípios são universais e imutáveis, eles definem o que acreditamos ser correto e verdadeiro, além de nos unir, nos inspirar e guiar nossas decisões. Nosso princípio de apoiar a Diversidade e Inclusão descreve que tratamos todos igualmente, com dignidade e respeito. Por que a equidade, igualdade, diversidade e inclusão importam.


Para nossas pessoas: Nós maximizamos o potencial de cada colaborador quando permitimos que cada um seja si mesmo no trabalho e quando tratamos todos com respeito e dignidade. O melhor pensamento pode vir de qualquer parte da organização, de modo que os colaboradores devem ter a liberdade de compartilhar suas perspectivas e se desafiar mutuamente.

Para o nosso negócio: Como a equidade, diversidade e inclusão são bons para nossos colaboradores e para nossos pacientes, fortalecerão nosso desempenho nos negócios. Eles nos ajudam a inovar, entender nossos clientes e reter os melhores talentos.


Este banco de talentos é destinado exclusivamente a pessoas com deficiência. Todos os currículos serão cuidadosamente analisados e futuramente os profissionais serão contatados ao surgir oportunidades que sejam compatíveis com os seus perfis.


Buscamos por profissionais em diversas áreas como: Administrativa, Financeiro, Vendas, Atendimento ao Cliente, Recursos Humanos, Facilities, Marketing, Qualidade, Assuntos Regulatórios, Manufatura, Logística, Acesso e outras.


Localidade: nossos escritórios administrativos estão localizados em São Paulo, nossa planta fabril em Guarulhos (SP) e contamos com diversos colaboradores de Vendas atuando em todo Brasil.

AbbVie is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives, serving our community and embracing diversity and inclusion. description:
